caption: The drawing depicts a single ceramic jug positioned centrally on a plain, off-white background. The jug is cylindrical with a rounded shoulder tapering to a short, narrow neck and small mouth. A sturdy, curved handle is attached from the upper neck to the shoulder of the vessel. The body of the jug is adorned with an irregular textured pattern of dark brown lines over a surface predominantly colored with shades of brown and greenish-blue, giving a mottled appearance. The jug’s base is slightly wider, and subtle highlights suggest the glossy finish of the ceramic material. The composition is simple, featuring only the jug with no additional objects or background details, except for a faint, rectangular border surrounding the image and a discreet artist signature—"Annie B. Johnston"—in the lower right corner.
title: Stoneware Jug
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
